2608.26848.title: MedFG-VQA: Low-Frequency Memory and Graph Attention for Lightweight Medical VQA
2608.26848.paper_summary: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) holds significant promise for clinical decision support, yet faces challenges due to limited annotated data and the high computational demands of existing large vision-language models. We propose MedFG-VQA, a lightweight framework that leverages a memory bank to augment DCT-based low-frequency features and employs graph-enhanced cross-attention for effective visual-textual alignment. Specifically, our approach features two key components: Frequency-Memory Fusion (FMF), which enhances low-frequency features by retrieving from a learnable memory bank built on DCT decomposition, and Graph-Aware Cross-Attention (GACA), which aligns visual-textual features via cross-attention and refines them through graph-convolutional aggregation. To address data scarcity, we construct SynMed-VQA, a large-scale synthetic dataset comprising over 2 million question-answer pairs across 9 imaging modalities and 10 major organs, generated with GPT-4o. Extensive experiments on SynMed-VQA and three other standard biomedical VQA benchmarks demonstrate that MedFG-VQA achieves competitive or superior performance compared to much larger models while maintaining significantly lower computational costs, highlighting its efficiency and potential for clinical deployment.
2608.26848.paper_summary_zh: 醫療視覺問題回答（Med-VQA）在臨床決策支持方面具有重要潛力，但由於標註數據有限以及現有大型視覺-語言模型的高計算需求，面臨挑戰。我們提出了 MedFG-VQA，一個輕量級框架，利用記憶庫來增強基於 DCT 的低頻特徵，並採用圖增強的交叉注意力來實現有效的視覺-文本對齊。具體而言，我們的方法包含兩個關鍵組件：頻率-記憶融合（FMF），通過從基於 DCT 分解構建的可學習記憶庫中檢索來增強低頻特徵，以及圖感知交叉注意力（GACA），通過交叉注意力對視覺-文本特徵進行對齊，並通過圖卷積聚合進行精煉。為了解決數據稀缺問題，我們構建了 SynMed-VQA，一個大型合成數據集，包含超過 200 萬個問題-答案對，涵蓋 9 種成像模式和 10 個主要器官，使用 GPT-4o 生成。在 SynMed-VQA 和其他三個標準生物醫學 VQA 基準上的廣泛實驗表明，MedFG-VQA 在性能上與更大型模型相當或優越，同時保持顯著較低的計算成本，突顯了其效率及在臨床部署中的潛力。
